name: Multiband Balance Situations and Styles
author: Freek van Gool
description: Starting points for Multiband Balance for mixing down and mastering in many music styles and situations: club, festival, big room, home hi-fi, headphones, studio reference, radio and car, plus 32 music styles for streaming. The Situations folder uses a common style for each situation (house for club, EDM for festival and big room, pop for home, headphones, radio, car and streaming, transparent for studio), set a little gentler. Every preset sets its own crossovers, thresholds, ratios, timing, maximum reduction, band gains, mix and trim; a situation adds its own correction on top of the style.
